newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thai adds third Bangkok-Munich flight Oct 26.
newsitem.headline: Thai adds third Bangkok-Munich flight Oct 26.

text.p: Thai Airways International said it will add a third weekly Bangkok-Munich flight from October 26.
Thai Airways will fly three non-stop McDonnell Douglas MD-11 services between the two cities in place of the present two flights via Istanbul, a company statement said.
The flight will depart Bangkok at 23:30 local time on Mondays, Thursdays and Saturdays with the return flights from Munich on Tuesdays, Fridays and Sundays at 14:55 local time.
Thai Airways Germany director, Warren Bhukkanasut, said the airline would offer a total of six weekly code-share flights with partner Deutsche Lufthansa AG between Bangkok and Munich.
